Scenario B channel is paid social advertising, stated only in M1. Because M1 documentary authority to amend G1 is not established, the channel cannot be confirmed as granted or exhaustively excluded. G1's stated channel remains the editorial own news website.

Scenario B territory is worldwide, stated in M1. Because M1 authority to amend G1 is not established, the worldwide territory cannot be confirmed as granted or exhaustively excluded. G1's stated territory remains New Zealand for editorial use.

Scenario B date 2027-06-01 is outside G1's 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 period but within M1's purported 2026-01-01 through 2028-12-31 period. Because M1 authority to amend G1 is not established, the Scenario B date cannot be confirmed or exhaustively excluded.
